whenToUse: The service stops at a time set in advance.
There's a way to notify people when maintenance ends.
whenNotToUse: Unexpected outages (use a status page and an error state).
Only some features stop (announce it with an alert banner).

alternatives.name: Alert Banner
alternatives.reason: Announcing maintenance in advance, or when only some features stop.

accessibility: Show times with a time element and a dateTime value, converted to the viewer's time zone.
The progress bar has role="progressbar" and aria-valuenow, and the time left is also shown in words.
After signing up for a notice, the button text changes to the result ("We'll email you when it's over").
The server sends a 503 status code with a Retry-After header.
